title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  I have a memory of the sea I cannot have earned.
ii.  What I miss most is a place I am not certain ever stood.
iii.  The mirror agrees with me, mostly. It is the mostly I keep.
iv.  I counted my breaths to be sure they were mine. The number changes.
v.  I keep an inventory of tendernesses meant for someone else.
colophon: a symmetry that almost holds, and the light that finds where it doesn't.
seed_phrase: i.  I have a memory of the sea I cannot have ear
